name: SRS language learning app with story worlds

mentions.name: SRS language learning app with story worlds
mentions.description: A language learning app that keeps track of the user's SRS (spaced repetition) study items and builds stories set in worlds the user creates to help review them, combining the author's favorite aspects of other language learning apps.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a language learning app.

At its most basic it keeps track of all your SRS-y things for you and builds stories in worlds you can create to help review them, but it's so much more.
mentions.author: JimboOmega
